title: Redesign: Allow dismissing announcements panel
body: > [!NOTE] > This is part of work for an upcoming feature that is not complete. This is not ready for testing, feedback, or bug reports. Read more [here](https://blog.joinmastodon.org/2026/08/5.0-laying-the-foundation/). ### Changes proposed in this PR: - A follow-up to #40674, this allows dismissing the Announcements panel when it's visible. It also moves all its display logic back into Redux, so there's only a single bit of state that determines whether the panel is shown or not. - Removes auto-hiding of the Announcements panel, as it doesn't seem necessary now. It still only shows up after a page refresh if there are unread announcements, but it will persist for the session until dismissed. ### Screenshots | **Before** | **After** | |--------|--------| | | |
